request: このカノンとネイラスの画像から、カード絵を描いて。カノンはこのタイトル絵を参考に制服姿と巫女服の姿を重ねる。ネイラスは幻想魔法で光の蝶を呼び出して舞わせる。

deliverables.name: カノン
deliverables.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished collectible character card illustration for CROSSOVER DUEL C72 カノン / Canon. Portrait 2:3, 1024x1536, opaque edge-to-edge illustration, no printed card UI.
Input image 1: primary identity, uniform costume, miko costume, visual style and double-exposure composition reference. The two depicted women are TWO ASPECTS OF THE SAME WOMAN カノン, not different characters. Use the illustration only; discard all title lettering and decorative header rules.
Primary request: create an entirely new beautifully resolved card artwork closely based on this title image, layering カノン's school-uniform self with her shrine-maiden kagura self.
Composition: the school-uniform カノン is the solid, sharply drawn foreground protagonist, centered from head to hips; place her face around 43% down the portrait so it remains prominent. Behind and above her, a much larger luminous translucent vision of THE SAME カノン dances kagura in white-and-vermilion shrine-maiden clothing, upper body sweeping diagonally across the top half, eyes softly closed in graceful profile, one raised arm holding a real golden kagura bell wand, the other arm extended, broad white sleeves flowing. Place the miko face around 23% down, visible separately from the foreground face. The upper aspect softly blends with the golden background as intentional cinematic double exposure, but both faces and both costumes remain anatomically coherent and clearly legible. No panels or split-screen.
Identity: faithful delicate Japanese anime face as reference, long straight glossy black hair, reddish dark-brown eyes, warm open smile for foreground, gold-and-vermilion hair clip. Foreground wears the EXACT reference's gold-ochre short shoulder cape with ornate gold embroidery and deep dark lining, dark brown tailored double-breasted vest with gold trim and buttons, crisp white collared shirt, diagonal gold-and-dark-brown striped tie, sapphire-blue jewel in a gold brooch and fine gold chains. Hair loose and flowing. Preserve youthful slender proportions and modest fully clothed design.
Miko aspect: same black hair in an elaborate updo with fine gold and vermilion kanzashi and dangling ornaments, white wide sleeves with gold embroidered edging, red-and-gold obi and vermilion lower cloth, trailing red ribbons, multi-bell golden kagura wand. This is a symbolic layered portrait of her own kagura identity.
Backdrop: golden sunset over softly detailed rice heads and a distant Eastern shrine/castle landscape and torii, like the reference's luminous remembered homeland, warm amber light, subtle motes and light trails connecting the two aspects. The landscape is symbolic memory, not a new event in her biography.
Style: match the supplied highly polished Japanese fantasy anime illustration, refined delicate linework, expressive eyes, flowing hair, carefully rendered embroidered fabrics and metal, luminous warm atmospheric light, controlled visual depth. Clear elegant silhouettes even at card size. All important faces and hands in central 80%. Foreground lower torso may reach bottom edge.
Constraints: only カノン, shown twice as the same person's uniform and miko aspects. No Neiras, no other people, no title, no text, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no border, no trading-card frame, no weapons or invented attack magic. No accidental merging of hands, sleeves or bodies, no extra limbs. Do not crop off raised hand or kagura bell wand.
deliverables.visual_review: 制服姿の前景と結い髪の巫女姿の重なり、神楽鈴、金色の風景、文字と枠がないことを目視確認。

deliverables.name: ネイラス
deliverables.reference: /Volumes/share/Picture/レガリオ王立魔術学院/Upscaled/ネイラス_ポーズ集１.png
deliverables.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished collectible character card illustration for CROSSOVER DUEL C71 ネイラス / Neiras. Portrait 2:3, 1024x1536, opaque edge-to-edge artwork with no card UI.
Input image 1: exclusive reference for Neiras's identity, exact school-uniform costume, body proportions, and polished Japanese anime drawing style. The sheet shows several poses of ONE MAN; depict him ONLY ONCE in a new coherent illustrated scene.
Primary request: ネイラス uses illusion magic to conjure luminous butterflies and make them dance around him.
Subject: faithful slender tall 20-year-old male anime illusionist with silver/platinum medium-length layered tousled hair, golden amber eyes, delicate handsome androgynous face, confident warm theatrical playful smile, and fine dangling gold cross-shaped earrings as reference. Keep exact reference outfit: gold-ochre short shoulder cape with ornate gold embroidery, deep dark purple lining, dark-brown fitted vest edged in gold with gold buttons and fine gold chains, white collared shirt with elegant ruffled cuffs, gold-and-dark diagonal striped tie, sapphire-blue gold-framed brooch, dark-brown slim trousers. No redesign into white stage costume.
Composition/framing: single dominant head-to-mid-thigh portrait. Face in upper central area about 26% down, clearly readable and unobscured. He faces viewer in a natural three-quarter stance with a fluid showman's flourish. One arm is raised with hand beside but below the face, fingers elegantly open; a small radiant butterfly is emerging just above the fingertips. Other hand open at waist-to-chest height, guiding a stream of light butterflies across the composition. Both hands fully visible, relaxed correct anatomy and no extreme foreshortening. Cape flares gracefully to one side showing dark lining and gold embroideries, framing body.
Illusion magic: around 15 to 22 beautifully distinct luminous light-butterflies, translucent sculpted wing shapes made of gold, pearlescent white, pale pink, lavender and faint cyan light. A graceful spiraling arc starts at the raised hand, curls around the lower open hand and rises behind the shoulder into upper space. A few larger butterflies in foreground for depth, smaller ones farther back. Fine flowing light trails establish their dancing motion. These are harmless projections of light, never solid summoned animals. Do not hide his face, eyes, hands, tie or sapphire brooch with butterflies or excessive bloom.
Backdrop: softly atmospheric deep indigo-violet magical academy gallery with distant arched windows, subtle gold details and floating light, enough darkness for radiant butterflies to glow. No crowd or other characters. Warm golden butterfly light reflects on his face and cape; cool blue-violet atmosphere adds depth. Express wonder, charm and showmanship.
Style: refined clean Japanese fantasy anime illustration faithful to supplied sheet, fine confident linework, soft cel shading and careful material rendering, luminous eyes, high detail in gold textile motifs, smooth natural hands. Dramatic coherent collectible-card composition, clear focal hierarchy at small size.
Constraints: one Neiras only; correct silver hair and golden eyes; preserve gold/brown/white/blue uniform. No hat, staff, sword, literal angel wings, white stage suit, girl, extra people, collage, duplicated figure, text, numbers, card frame, border, logo or watermark.
